label: End-of-episode (low value) unit: rewarded D1 and a2 choices at GO
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (ep_trial 90-99 holds 99.9% of activations; never before trial 80), equivalently only when the value head is low (all activations in the lowest value bin, value < 5.2). It is the end-of-episode / time-remaining signal. Within that window it fires on D1 when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1, 61% of mass) and on GO when the agent picks a2 (action=2 at GO is its own upcoming choice, computed at that step). It essentially never fires at D2 (3% of mass, only S2 states) and never on a1 or S1 inputs. Magnitude rises over the last trials as the episode end and lower value approach (activations ramp across the window). ep_trial>=90 alone gets recall 0.997 but precision 0.11; tightening to value<3.5 plus the phase/input conditions gives dev F1 0.72, mass recall 0.90. The value threshold is a stand-in for the agent tracking time-to-end. Uses no future variables: action at GO is the agent's own choice.
